title: Recordings and sounds can go into the Library without going onto the timeline
goal: The video mock fills the Library first (Import, a file dropped onto the Library, a new capture) and only then drags a first clip onto an empty track. Today a recording or sound only reaches the Library by landing on the timeline, so a blank video project cannot be started the way the mock shows.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html onboarding step 2 (Fill the Library, line ~326, view ~691) and the Library header + button (data-menu #libMenu, line ~530). The pool exists since recordings-and-sounds-in-a-document-sit-on-the-l: PhotonzDocument.media + rememberMedia (Sources/PhotonzCore/DocumentClipMedia.swift); adding to the shelf is perform { $0.rememberMedia(...) } after MovieLibrary/SoundLibrary read the file. The shelf already takes colour drops (LibraryColorDrop.swift), so a file drop must be added alongside without breaking that. Capture landing new recordings in the Library is the third way in the mock; decide in the task whether it belongs here.
acceptance: A recording or sound dropped from the Finder onto the Library shelf becomes a tile there and lands nowhere else
The Library header has the mock's add button with Import, which puts the chosen files on the shelf
File > Import Media… (Shift Command I, as the mock's File menu) is there at Next defaults with the Library folded, and what it imports is visible afterwards because the Library opens to show it
A walk at Next defaults drops a file onto the Library, then drags its tile onto an empty track
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
